description: Send Allow/Deny to the phone and return a durable pending requestId. IMPORTANT: after this tool returns pending, call nofax_wait_for_response and repeat while it remains pending. Never continue the guarded action without a terminal Allow response. Set allowRefine when the human should also be able to send refinement text.

allowRefine.description: When true, also let the human return free-text refinement instead of only Allow or Deny.

message.description: Guarded action or decision context shown to the human.

title.description: Optional approval prompt title shown to the human; defaults to "Nofax approval".

name: nofax_request_approval

instruction.description: Fail-closed next-step instruction for the caller.

mustWait.description: Signals that the caller must keep waiting for a terminal human response.

status.description: The request is unresolved and must not be treated as approval.

title: Request human approval
